desc: Formalize feasibility by reducing to the P- and Q-cycles containing X and rejecting initially present colors outside those cycles.
Derive the reduced two-path scheduling formulation as a shortest common supersequence problem.
Develop an O(N log N) minimum-operation algorithm using LCS via LIS.
Validate handling of no-ball, self-loop, disconnected-cycle, mixed-arrival edge cases, and all public samples.
